decoded.hypothesis: The previous programs suffered from long instruction chains, particularly with division operations, leading to stalls and reduced rates in later bins. Segment 3's body was too long. Segment 4's body was also too long. The new programs will shorten the instruction chains within segments, especially focusing on segments that previously contained many division instructions, to improve instruction retirement rates and achieve a flatter profile. I predict that reducing the instruction count in the body of segments will increase the rates in the bins where those segments execute.
